panel.title: Boiler
panel.not_running: Smart Boiler is not running. Check its entry under Settings → Devices & services.
panel.error: The page could not read Smart Boiler's data: {message}

status.monitoring_detail: Control is not set up: the plugin watches the boiler and counts.
status.heat_called: Called for heat — the burner is not lit right now

control.label: Control
control.hint_settings: Switched in the plugin's settings: Control mode, Control on.
control.admin_only: Only an administrator changes this, in the plugin's settings.
control.replay_hint: A past moment: nothing can be changed.

tiles.water_waiting: waiting for the boiler to confirm

schematic.title: Installation
schematic.legend_moving: white dashes — the water flows · green — a pump or valve at work

curve.title: Heating curve
curve.where_detail: outdoors, as the curve reads it → water · curve's room {room}
curve.no_curve: Control does not set the water here, so there is no curve.
curve.not_entered: The curve is not entered yet: set it in the plugin's settings.
curve.axis: Outdoor temperature (°C), colder to the right — up: water (°C)
curve.preview_hint: Drag the blue point — the hardest frost — or use the arrow keys; the slider shifts the whole curve.
curve.handle: Point at the hardest frost: {outdoor} outdoors, {water} water. The arrow keys move it.
curve.preview_note: The preview changes nothing in the boiler. To change the curve, use the plugin's settings; saving from this page comes next.
curve.loading_error: The curve could not be read: {message}

problem.design_flow_too_low: The water at the hardest frost must be at least 5 °C above the curve's room temperature.
problem.design_flow_above_hard_max: The water at the hardest frost is above the highest water: the curve would be cut off in frost.
problem.design_outdoor_too_warm: The hardest frost must be at least 10 °C below the curve's room temperature.
problem.hard_min_not_below_design_flow: The lowest water must be below the water at the hardest frost.
problem.hard_min_above_max: The lowest water is above a circuit's or the boiler's highest.
problem.out_of_range: a value is outside what the settings accept.
problem.offset_advanced: the offset is set at the advanced level of the plugin's settings.
problem.needs_settings: the settings need you for this save — open them to finish.

curve.save_body: The plugin's settings save it with their own checks and reload once; control goes on with the new curve.
curve.saved: Saved: the plugin reloads its settings.
curve.admin_only: Only an administrator can save the curve.

timeline.title: The last 24 h
timeline.hint: Scroll or play the day back: the tiles, the schematic and the curve show that moment.
timeline.hint_alone: Scroll or play the day back: the chart, the burns and the legend show that moment.
timeline.no_history: No history: the recorder keeps none for these entities.
timeline.error: The history could not be read: {message}

burner.condensing_share_detail: heating burn time with the return below 55 °C
burner.summary: {count} burns in the last 24 h: {heat} heating, {dhw} hot water, {unknown} of unknown kind.
burner.lengths: How long the heating burns lasted
burner.lengths_hint: Burns of the last 24 h by length. Short burns wear the boiler and waste gas.
burner.as_of: As the monitor's analysis of {time} sees them.
burner.none: No burns in the last 24 h.
burner.no_analysis: The monitor has not analysed the burns yet.
burner.error: The burns could not be read: {message}

use.gas_per_degree_day_detail: the last 7 days — measured with a gas meter, else estimated
use.degree_days_detail: the last 7 days, from the heating threshold
use.weeks_hint: How much gas the house needs for each degree of cold. The weather evens out, so the weeks compare. Lower is better.
use.week_band: Week of {date}: {value} (likely {low}–{high}, from the house's own day-to-day scatter)

why.no_week: not known yet — the daily summaries are filled day by day
why.days: not known yet — it needs 7 whole days of data
why.gas: not known — gas is missing on at least one day: no gas meter reading, and no estimate from the modulation
why.degree_days: not known — the outdoor temperature is missing on at least one day
why.mild: not known — the days were too mild to compare
why.other: not known now — the monitor has no value for the last 7 days

use.weeks_none: No week yet: the daily summaries are filled day by day.
use.no_report: No report yet: it needs two days of data.
use.error: The use could not be read: {message}

checks.left_out: {count} days left out: the plugin controlled the boiler in them
checks.verdict_hint: Whether control is worth enabling, from the days the plugin only watched the boiler. The reasons below say why.
checks.sizing_load: the house needs about {value} kW at {outdoor} °C (its design load)
checks.no_alarm: No alarm or warning is active.
checks.alarms_hint: Pick one for its history. The monitor's alarms only inform: they never change control.
checks.building_hint: What the plugin knows about the house. A value you entered always wins; a measured one is fitted from the monitored days.
checks.admin_only: Only an administrator can forget a measured value.
checks.reset_body: The measured value is forgotten and fitted again from the days that start after now. A value you entered stays and wins as before. Control and the settings do not change.
checks.reset_failed: The value could not be forgotten: {message}
checks.lowest_water_hint: The plugin never applies it: a value to consider for the curve's lowest water temperature, in the settings.

journal.title: Journal
journal.hint: What the plugin decided and why. Drag across the lanes to zoom in. It keeps {days} days, {max} entries at most.
journal.error: The journal could not be read: {message}
journal.circuit_need: A circuit's need holds the water at {value}
journal.circuit_need_end: A circuit's need no longer holds the water

analyses.not_fitted: Not fitted (warm, or no heating gas)
analyses.signature_hint: Each day's heating gas against its mean outdoor temperature. Colder days take more; the line says how much more per degree. Days under control are drawn apart, so the two compare in the same weather.
analyses.no_days: No day yet: the daily summaries are filled day by day, where gas and the outdoor temperature are known.
analyses.y_unit: Up: heating gas per day ({unit}). Across: the day's mean outdoor temperature.
analyses.y_estimated: Up: heating gas per day, estimated from the modulation in the unit of the boiler's gas figures. Across: the day's mean outdoor temperature.
analyses.line: {slope} more for each degree colder; no heating gas from {balance} °C up ({days} days, R² {r2})
analyses.no_line_too_few_days: no line yet — it needs {days} heating days or more
analyses.no_line_too_little_spread: no line yet — the days' outdoor temperatures must spread over {spread} K or more
analyses.no_line_not_heating: no line — colder days did not take more gas
analyses.no_line_too_scattered: no line — the days scatter too much for one
analyses.compare_less: At {outdoor} °C: watching only {observing} a day, under control {control} — {percent} % less (likely {from}–{to} % less).
analyses.compare_more: At {outdoor} °C: watching only {observing} a day, under control {control} — {percent} % more (likely {from}–{to} % more).
analyses.compare_none: At {outdoor} °C: watching only {observing} a day, under control {control}. No difference shown: the days scatter more than the two lines lie apart.
analyses.starts_hint: Heating starts in each hour of the last 4 weeks, darker for more. Many hours in a row with starts mean the boiler cycles; the bottom row is each hour's mean.
analyses.hours_zone: Days and hours in Home Assistant's time zone ({zone}).
analyses.error: The analyses could not be read: {message}

cards.status_detail: Smart Boiler's status with its reasons, the Control switch and the tiles.
cards.schematic_detail: The heating installation drawn from Smart Boiler's settings, with the circuits taking heat now.
cards.curve_detail: The heating curve with where Smart Boiler is now and its last 7 days; an administrator can preview and save a change.
cards.timeline_detail: The last 24 hours from the recorder — the water, flow, return and burns — with a scrubber and play.
